name: Synth Sun

steps.script: for (const e of project.elements) if (e.showWhen === 'sunrise' || e.showWhen === 'sunset') delete e.showWhen; return 1

description: Retro synthwave sunset with Romanian full weekday names (language ro-RO, set "language" in recipe.json to change): striped sun with a steps arc over a neon grid, with icon pills for the readings.
